+Introducing @postman/api-sdk: the official TypeScript SDK for the Postman API
+Diego Garcia
+Meet @postman/api-sdk, the official typed TypeScript client for the Postman API. Install it from npm and script your workspace with autocomplete.
+Read more →
-Postman’s 3 Layers of API Secret Protection Explained
-Tara Wyman
-Learn how Postman’s three-layer secret protection model stops credential leaks at save, sync, and runtime. See how to secure API secrets end to end.
-Read more →
